home.title: Cozy Safe: an open-source encrypted vault
home.desc: Cozy Safe keeps your notes, documents and photos encrypted on your own device. Free and open source, for macOS, Windows, Linux and Android.
home.h1: A private vault for your notes, documents and photos.
home.lead: Everything is encrypted on your device before it is saved or synced. Without your password, nobody can open it, including us.
home.note: Early preview. You can create, unlock and lock vaults. Notes, files, photos and sync arrive in later releases, so don't keep the only copy of anything important here yet.
home.h_how: How Cozy Safe keeps you safe
home.p_how: Your data never leaves your device unencrypted, and the code that does it is public.
home.c1p: Data is encrypted before it reaches the disk or a cloud folder. Sync only ever sends encrypted data.
home.c2p: Your password is combined with a random 128-bit key kept on your device, so someone holding a copy of your vault still cannot guess the password.
home.c3p: Anyone can read and check the code (GPL-3.0). Installers are built by GitHub, with provenance you can verify.
l1: If you forget the password, nobody can open the vault again, including us.
Choose a password you will remember, such as a phrase of several words.
l2: It cannot protect a device that already has malware.
Others can still see that Cozy Safe is installed.
Anyone who knows the password can open the vault.
home.mac: Signed and notarized by Apple. Open the disk image and drag Cozy Safe into Applications.
home.win: Not signed yet: if SmartScreen warns you, choose More info, then Run anyway.
home.andr: Signed with the Cozy Pi key. When Android asks, allow your browser to install apps.
home.ios: Coming soon through TestFlight, Apple's app for testing new apps.
home.verify: To check a download, compare it with SHA256SUMS.txt or run gh attestation verify <file> -R cozy-pi/cozysafe. Older versions are on the releases page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy · Cozy Safe
body: In short
Cozy Safe does not collect, send or sell any of your data. There is no account, no analytics, no advertising and no tracking in the app.
Everything you put in a vault is encrypted on your device. We cannot read it and we have no copy of it.
What stays on your device
Your vaults, notes, files and photos, always encrypted with keys derived from your password and Secret Key.
App settings such as language and light or dark mode.
Where your data can go, only if you choose

Sync and backup use a folder or device you pick (for example iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox, or another device on your network). Only encrypted data is written there; the provider you choose cannot read it.
If you turn on Secret Key sync, the Secret Key is stored in your platform's end-to-end encrypted password store (iCloud Keychain or Google Password Manager), under that provider's privacy terms.
When you share, export or open an item in another app, that app receives an unencrypted copy and handles it under its own terms.
Permissions
Camera: only to take photos straight into a vault, when you open the camera. Photos are not saved to your photo library.
Biometrics: only if you turn on Face ID, Touch ID or fingerprint unlock. Your biometric data never leaves the device's secure hardware and is never available to the app.
This website

safe.cozypi.com is a set of static pages served by Cloudflare. It sets no cookies and runs no analytics. Cloudflare may keep standard technical logs (such as IP address) for security, under its own privacy policy. Downloads are served by GitHub.
Children
Cozy Safe is not directed at children under 13 and collects no data from anyone.
Changes and contact
If this policy changes, the new version will be published on this page with a new date.
Questions: support@cozypi.com. Cozy Safe is made by Cozy Pi, an independent studio, and its source code is public at github.com/cozy-pi/cozysafe.
